plugin.name: HTTP request
plugin.description: Send an HTTP request and read the response. Secrets are written as {{secret:name}} and filled in by OneDesk.
field.headers.placeholder: One per line: Name: value. A secret is written as {{secret:name}}.
field.body.placeholder: Request body (not sent with GET and HEAD). Parameters are written as :name.
headers.name: Header
field.token.hint: Written to the keychain; use {{token}} in the headers.
field.query.placeholder: One per line: name=value. Added to the address and percent-encoded.
info.name: Item
field.connection.hint: The address becomes a path below the connection's address; the connection adds the authentication.
error.connectionAnswer: The connection returned an answer that could not be read.
